claims.text:
9. cold-start

Target / packet: ai-cold-start · R1. Prerequisites: ai:collaborative-filtering.

Nearest / distinct payoff: collaborative-filtering → ai-collaborative-filtering. Collaborative recommendation needs co-interactions; this makes absent item/user evidence and a separate side-information fallback explicit.

Finite primary model: Add item D with zero interactions in all three existing users; collaborative weighted score D=0 from no positive evidence. New user[0,0,0,0] has zero norm, so cosine recommendation is unavailable, not meaningful confidence 0.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Declared side-information fallback marks D topic match 1 and scores it 1; this uses a new evidence source. Zero interaction score does not establish dislike. Also show established item C remains 1 for old U 1.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict which recommendation cannot be supported by co-interaction data; recall how one new interaction changes available evidence.

Required observable evidence: Represent undefined new user similarity explicitly; distinguish missing support from a low measured rating.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
